subject: 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole conducted a midyear review of its 2024–2025 governing agenda, hearing progress updates from each committee chair. The council approved a motion directing chairs to submit updates so council leadership can publish a revised agenda.

items.title: Paper 24-006: Governing Agenda Introduction and Education and Culture Committee
items.summary: Vice President Collins introduced the midyear check-in on the council's term priorities and noted that the Education and Culture Committee has not taken up any major legislative projects yet.

items.title: Governance Committee Update
items.summary: Councilor Tseng reported on concluding the 2023 elections oversight review and outlined efforts to begin review of draft charter revisions.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Update
items.summary: Vice President Collins reviewed progress on citywide comprehensive zoning reform with consultant Innes Associates, the condo conversion ordinance, fee schedule updates, and pending home rule petitions.

items.title: Public Health and Community Safety Committee Update
items.summary: Councilor Lazzaro outlined initial discussions regarding municipal warming and cooling centers, drafting of a wildlife feeding ordinance, and updates to surveillance reporting.

items.title: Public Works and Facilities Committee Update
items.summary: Councilor Callahan summarized work monitoring street and sidewalk repair, utility repaving accountability, and an upcoming facility review with the building commissioner.

items.title: Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee Update
items.summary: Councilor Leming reported on modernizing council communications through monthly newsletters, YouTube meeting broadcasts, and constituent listening sessions.

items.title: Committee of the Whole and Administration and Finance Committee Updates
items.summary: President Bears reported on tree, leaf blower, and food truck ordinances in the Committee of the Whole, and highlighted the newly ordained budget ordinance and three approved fall ballot questions in Administration and Finance.

items.title: Motion to Update the Governing Agenda
items.summary: The council approved a motion directing committee chairs to submit committee updates to the council president and vice president to publish a revised governing agenda document.
